theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_trichotomy
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (E : Set (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ), IsSigmaCompact E → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) E < ∞ → 0 < δ → ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure (Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N)), ∀ᵐ a ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E), (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)) (E ∩ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖}) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (η * (r * s) ^ (m + 1))) ∨ dimensionalUpperDensity (Measure.map (fun x : Eucl N => (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) x) : Eucl (m + 1))) ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl N)).restrict E)).toOuterMeasure ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) univ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) a) : Eucl (m + 1)) = ⊤ ∨ ∃ x ∈ E, x ≠ a ∧ dist x a < δ ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) x) : Eucl (m + 1)) = (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (v i) a) : Eucl (m + 1))
